programs.title: Love It or List It
programs.desc: Years after updating their main living area, a couple looks to remedy their dysfunctional space with a third-floor renovation; one feels their dream home is within reach, but the other wants to find a new, perfect place.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: Ben and Erin return to help the siblings with phase two of a renovation; the project unfortunately stalled after their father passed away but now, the Napiers are back to help finish the house.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: A woman found her dream home in Laurel, but her contractor ran off with her money and left her with an unlivable space; after two years of paying a mortgage, rent, and storing all her belongings, she turns to Ben and Erin to rescue her dream home.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: With its last update 24 years ago, Ben and Erin renovate the local hospital maternity ward; it's full of family memories, including the birth of their two daughters, and they aim to transform it into a modern, welcoming space that feels like home.

programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together
programs.desc: Ben and Erin help their best friends turn a dilapidated 1930s department store into Laurel's first boutique hotel; with crushing financial risks and six months to open, they must finish a prototype room to secure bookings.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: A Place to Retreat: Costa Rica and Australia
programs.desc: Families hope tropical paradises in Costa Rica and Australia will offer a break from an overwhelming world, but they soon learn that serenity is hard to find when they're also trying to run the very retreat they need.
